origin: The program that compares every candidate directly with the teammate's original single-tree fit nominated half original tree and half relative-measurement tree when all three development panels were combined. The three leave-one-panel-out selections collectively beat the original by 19/2432 and trailed the earlier research pair by 11/2432. Freeze this new nomination before looking at any label scores on the concurrent 48-fit study.
larger_training: Use precisely the three current fresh anonymous training/query packages. Refit the nominee's two constituent estimators on each complete anonymous training packet; no search or updates on query rows. Save probability and row-order receipts for the single and the program's proposed blend before either nine-arm result or any of these predictions is scored. Six physical fits; no model API.
decision: Compare the frozen research proposal against its actual teammate single constituent, the teammate's complete 48-fit ordinary entry and the current expanded ordinary entry. A credible signal for integration needs pooled +.003, at least two positive folds and no single-fold drop worse than .003 against all three. A frozen research recipe alone cannot be a course submission. Only then integrate the general learned measurement candidate into ordinary capability discovery and let the agent elect or reject it without a method hint. These evaluation partitions are new; they reuse course training rows seen at other stages.
